# Prospective original-AST first collector

Unexecuted preparation. Only this driver and README are authored here. Root must
finish its Formals commit and current binary/source barrier before freezing
inputs.json or running the collector with --inputs-sha256. No input map,
session.json or first observation is created during this preparation.

The driver defines exactly eighteen literal cases and finite/selected-auto ×
text/JSON forms: 72 check commands. It uses the original complete schema2 projects
and original main.qli paths. A metadata command list only checks equality; it is
never executed. Predictions are not read as an oracle. The fixed current MSRV
CLI d219e3cb0e546c8173ab1215ffd94cacc7c032ce9abd145b98949bbb2c4d089e and
native39effde0f152a2c926fcea3a7f99fc2f25f9de65906be2b8c527508353c90c85
remain separate identities. The unchanged logging forwarder and reviewed
streaming helper supply the same 55-second outer and 1 MiB output/file ceilings.

The prospective map must pin identity() plus this driver, README, FIRST map and
guarded helper/forwarder bytes in frozen_files, and the 72 authored commands in
commands. identity() records all source Rust files, Cargo/config/build-script/
toolchain inputs if present, actual CLI embedded std/discovery sources, the
historical terminal MSRV 715-row maps/records and their currently selected input
bytes. The four unchanged bundled sources and manifest also match the immutable
registry control. Root captures checkout HEAD only after its commit. HEAD is an
identity marker; neither HEAD nor matching records attest a complete dependency,
toolchain, environment or build closure. Current production inputs must match
their consumed MSRV build rows. No old collector main/identity guard is invoked.

The source-only FIRST41, session.before and registry records remain immutable.
Every call is guarded before and after. The one-shot new before directory keeps
raw command/cwd/status, .stdout.bin/.stderr.bin/.native.jsonl, bounded process
errors, exact hashes and actual source associations. Native rows are pre-execv
forwarded invocation attempts, not independently attested starts/exits. Outer
group cleanup does not establish complete cleanup of separate native groups.
Real timeout/launch/output failures and partial results stay intact with no retry.

Only after every actual call completes does the driver write summary.json with
computed counts, identity.final, files.json and a new session.json referencing
the real observations. It does not claim expected success/rejection/native
counts, new semantic support, complete original-source judgment, canonical std,
source-preservation proof, guarantees or Issue completion. No runtime, sample,
emission or maximum/stress command exists.
